messages:
maria_ops: Heads up — inbound H100 batch from VendorX is stuck in FRA customs, RMA paperwork mismatch. ETA pushed +72h. This will reduce available pool for EU edge by ~18 units.

diego_procure: Ugh. Do we have the AWB + manifest? Vendor says they sent updated docs but customs flagged HS code mismatch.

maria_ops: Posted manifest and AWB earlier, but customs flagged serial range vs invoice. Here's the AWB and snapshots: 
```
AWB: 123-45678901
Manifest serials: H100-0001..H100-0200
Invoice: units 1..182
```

kai_infra: If that gap holds we hit soft capacity limits on eu-west-1 dedicated pool next week. Can we drain canaries and shift non-urgent training to us-central for 48–72h?

jen_product: Need to flag customers on reserved capacity. Diego — can procurement expedite an alternate forwarder on vendor side (air-rebook) and absorb cost? Customers on Dedicated have SLA exposures.

diego_procure: Rebook option exists but vendor says forwarder surcharge = +€12k and extra RMA handling fees if we split manifests. They offered to split shipment (air-expedite 20 units) but want cost share.

maria_ops: Proposal: Vendor covers brokerage delay fees; Redwood covers expedite surcharge for first 20 units. Remaining mismatch we reorder re-label + consolidation at FRA depot. That buys us 20 usable H100s in ~24h. Thoughts? :thinking:

kai_infra: 20 units buys ~10% headroom for eu pool. We can reprioritize low-QPS tasks. But we need serial-level receipts into inventory before we promote to production. Customs will insist on corrected invoice/HS.

diego_procure: I'll push vendor for corrected invoice. If they won't cover brokerage, suggest a 50/50 split on expedite. If they accept, I can sign off today and ask them to route to AltForwarder (FASTEX) which has a smaller lead time.

jen_product: Also: prepare a short customer-facing note (no internal blame) explaining limited capacity and mitigation (burst to us region, temporary throughput cap). Maria, Kai — can you draft bullet points?

maria_ops: Drafting now. Quick bullets: 1) Minor capacity impact in EU region for next 48–72h. 2) We've activated cross-region burst and prioritized critical workloads. 3) No data exposure. 4) We'll update within 24h.

kai_infra: Add: we recommend customers pin to dedicated model variants or enable multi-region routing to avoid throttles.

supplybot: VendorX updated docs uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-procure/vendorx/1764219999/manifest_v2.pdf

diego_procure: Vendor's onboard rep confirmed they can use FASTEX but require payment pre-authorization. I can approve up to €6k now; need finance signoff for remaining. Who can loop in finance?

maria_ops: I'll escalade to @linda_finance in #finance and copy PO. Linda — any quick OK to pre-authorize up to €6k for an expedite to unblock EU edge?

jen_product: Also, ops/infra — please capture impact metrics (queued requests, token drop rate) so customer note is factual. Kai — we need a short dashboard snippet.

kai_infra: On it. Will post a snapshot in 15m. Current queued tokens up 22% for eu-edge-avg instance group.

diego_procure: Update from VendorX: they will accept 60/40 split (Redwood 40%) if we sign a delivery amendment. That nets ~€7.8k charge to Redwood for 20-unit FASTEX rebook. Are we ok to commit?

maria_ops: If finance can greenlight 6–8k, do it. Priority is avoid SLA breaches. Confirm once payment tokenized; I'll coordinate FRA depot pickup and re-labeling.

jen_product: I'll draft the customer note and hold until Diego confirms payment route. Keep messaging neutral and focus on mitigation.

supplybot: Inventory system created temporary hold tag: HOLD-EU-RMA-1764219999 on SKUs H100-0001..H100-0020

diego_procure: Payment route confirmed via Linda (finance) for up to €8k. Vendor to send updated invoice + FASTEX AWB within 2 hours. Signing amendment now.

maria_ops: Great — once AWB received I will push FRA depot to clear and arrange customs broker. Kai, once serials enter inventory, mark them as "edge-ready".

kai_infra: Will monitor. If anything slips beyond 24h we'll trigger region-failover playbook.

jen_product: Customer note prepared, will send once diego confirms invoice and maria confirms 20 units cleared.

maria_ops: Closing loop — vendor sent FASTEX AWB: 987-65432100. Customs broker acknowledges receipt. ETA for 20 units now ~20h. Will update thread when they scan into depot. :white_check_mark:
